contexts.text: A deep sleep () = the state into which the man was let in order that he might seem to himself to have a proprium, which state is like sleep; for in it he knows not but that he lives, thinks, speaks, and acts from himself. And, when he begins to know that this is false, he arouses as from sleep, and becomes awake. AC 150, Explained, Illustrated.
Such drunkards think themselves more awake than others; but they are in a deep sleep.
A deep sleep fell upon Abram () = that the Church was then in darkness. A deep sleep = a dark state relatively to waking.
That man perceives this who is permitted to come from waking into many states of the softest sleep, and then of deep sleep.
Another was as it were dead... as if in a deep sleep.
